description: Renovate watches only the Supabase CLI pin in .mise.toml (and refreshes mise.lock). Dependabot keeps npm (.github/dependabot.yml).

packageRules.description: Only the Supabase CLI; node stays on its 24.x range in .mise.toml.
Minor and patch releases merge once the PR's required checks pass.
A major release (like 2.x to 3.x) can change deploy.yml's commands, which no PR check runs, so it waits for a person.
